title: A shear stress-responsive pathway in monocytes drives cardiopulmonary bypass-induced inflammation via spectrin/RAF1/store-operated calcium entry
model: IL8-GFP THP-1 monocytic cells, Brunello genome-wide library, sheared 2 h and FACS-sorted on GFP
contrast: Top 10% GFP vs next 25% after shear (1 vs 1, no replicates; screening-level); paper's design top 10% vs static + next 25% also run
paper_method: MAGeCK MLE (Data S1); candidates at Wald p < 0.05
paper_calls: 1,628 depleted candidate genes at Wald p < 0.05 (150 at Wald FDR 0.05; none at MAGeCK permutation FDR 0.72)
barcs_calls: 0 genes at FDR 0.10 for top 10% vs next 25%; 91 in the paper's design after control calibration, 0 against the control null; screening-level, no replicates
named_hits: 0/2 in the headline analysis (SPTAN1 p 0.32, RAF1 p 0.68); in the paper's design SPTAN1 FDR 0.047 but unconfirmed by the control null, RAF1 untestable (all guides 0 reads in the top-10% bin)
verdict: BARCS finds no hits: the top-10% bin lost 13% of guides to sampling dropout, about 12 genes are expected to lose all four guides by chance (12 did, RAF1 and MAGeCK's #1 OR4D9 among them), and the paper's SPTAN1/RAF1 calls rest on that dropout.
